findings.description: Using LOG_DEBUG in production can leak sensitive info (tokens, credentials, PII).

If the message ever comes from untrusted input and is passed directly to syslog as the format string (e.g., syslog(LOG_DEBUG, user_input)), an attacker can inject %n, %m, etc. Always use an explicit format like "%s".
Untrusted input containing newlines or control characters can forge/split log lines. Sanitize or encode control characters before logging.
Excessive debug logging can flood logs and impact performance/availability. Consider rate-limiting or masking debug level in production.
